design.what: the veil became the light field's palette bands (two cold blue-dark steps in the quiet) — nothing in the world translucent; v3.13 moved the grey's dim into the darkness layer a lantern burns through. The check measures the dim on the composited canvas: under half the ground's own brightness, blue-led, every tone of its ramp still its own

night became a palette field baked two steps deeper and bluer, lit ground keeping its day face — the full-screen veil deleted; v3.13 made the night a darkness layer that every light punches. The punch-through is measured on it
